messages:
Leah (PM): Quick sync — proposal for 'staggered sunrise/deprecation lanes' to reduce churn for enterprise customers. TL;DR: group onboarding into small cohorts, pair each cohort with a fixed deprecation window and rollback SLA. Thoughts? :seedling:
Diego (Eng): I like cohorting. Need concrete criteria for MVB (minimal viable benchmark) before a model can move from sunrise->general. What's MVB metric set?
Rina (Research): From eval side: propose 3 tests: perf P95 latency < 180ms for typical seq, pass NLL/regression threshold on core prompt set, and embedding cosine retention >= 0.92 vs baseline. We can call it 'MVB-3'.
Leah (PM): Good. Also thinking a contract layer: customer can pick 'Strict Pin' (no automatic migration) or 'Runway' (we migrate after window). Runway would have a 60d opt-in + 30d forced migration unless SLA escrow requested.
Samir (Customer Success): Customers will want visibility + a way to freeze for legal/regulatory. Add a 'freeze request' workflow for CS to file. Should map to console UI (freeze + reason + expiry).
Elliot (Sales): Sales note: enterprise deals will expect 90d grace for hardware-limited customers. Can we make lanes configurable per-customer? that'll affect ops and pricing.
Diego (Eng): Configurable lanes ok but need bounded complexity. Implementation idea: model metadata fields: band (alpha/beta/stable), migrate_after (timestamp), pin_mode (strict/runway/frozen). Keep default sane.
Leah (PM): Here's a quick sketch:

``
band: beta
migrate_after: 2026-06-15
pin_mode: runway
mvb: MVB-3
```

Ops should enforce migrate_after and trigger canaries + automated alerts.
ops-bot: deploy-hook: scheduled migration job created for model 'falconx-v2' -> window 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-30. Canary targets 1% traffic first.
Diego (Eng): For rollbacks, we need SLOs to detect quality regressions. Proposed: automatic rollback if eval drift > 4% on core prompts within 12h of canary.
Rina (Research): Add human-in-loop: auto-alert to PM/CS if drift between 2-4% so we can triage before rollback.
Samir (Customer Success): For customer freezes, CS needs 'escape hatch' approval from Security+Legal. Add a ticket template and SLA (48h review).
Leah (PM): Launch criteria checklist: MVB passed, canary pass (low-latency + quality), no critical customer freezes, rollout playbook, rollback plan, stakeholder comms + monitor dashboards.
Elliot (Sales): Need a negotiation template for contracts: default Lane = runway-60/30, enterprise can request runway-90/60 or strict pin at extra cost (one-time migration assistance fee).
Diego (Eng): Implementation notes: runtime routing needs to honor pin_mode per tenant. Design: DB flag + cached override at edge. Batching/cache behavior shouldn't change, but telemetry tags must include lane and migrate_after for auditing.
Leah (PM): Action items:
- Rina: formalize MVB-3 test harness (due 2026-04-20)
- Diego: schema + runtime design for pin_mode and migrate_after (due 2026-05-01)
- Samir: CS freeze ticket template + review workflow (due 2026-04-15)
- Elliot: contract addendum draft (due 2026-04-30)
- Leah: rollout playbook + comms draft (due 2026-05-05)

Agree? :white_check_mark:
Diego (Eng): Agree. small Q: do we want a 'soft deprecation' notification cadence? propose emails: 45d, 30d, 14d, 7d.
Samir (Customer Success): +1 to cadence, and include token-cost delta and migration runbook link in the 14d notice.
Leah (PM): Great. I'll set up a follow-up sync next week to review MVB examples and first cohort.
ops-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled 2026-03-30 10:00 PDT — 'staggered sunrise lanes: kickoff'
